item.title: Avalanche to Serve as Core Ledger Technology for Clearing and Settlement of NYSE-affiliated Upcoming Tokenized Securities Platform
item.title_en: Avalanche to Serve as Core Ledger Technology for Clearing and Settlement of NYSE-affiliated Upcoming Tokenized Securities Platform

title_i18n.ur: ایوالانچ این وائی ایس ای سے وابستہ آنے والے ٹوکنائزڈ سیکیورٹیز پلیٹ فارم کی کلیئرنگ اور سیٹلمنٹ کے لیے بنیادی کھاتہ ٹیکنالوجی ہوگا

title_i18n.sw: Avalanche itakuwa daftari kuu la usafishaji na malipo ya jukwaa lijalo la dhamana zilizotokenishwa linalohusiana na NYSE

item.summary: Ava Labs on 9 November 2026 announced that Avalanche will provide the core ledger technology to the clearing firm of a planned digital platform, affiliated with the New York Stock Exchange, for the trading and on-chain settlement of tokenized securities. The platform is under development and, subject to applicable regulatory approvals, is designed to allow 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement for its subscribers. The announcement does not say that the platform is in operation.
